### Our Mission Begins in Silence
Author: István Csernák
Site: The Upper Room
URL: https://www.upperroom.org/devotionals/blog-posts/2605
Passage: Acts 1:14
Points:
- After Christ's ascension, the disciples and believers gathered to wait faithfully and persistently in prayer.
- Christian prayer requires joining together with one heart, spirit, and common purpose.
- Practicing shared silence invites the presence and guidance of the Holy Spirit.
- Quieting ourselves before God is essential preparation before stepping into difficult ministry and mission.

### Day 228: Acts 1:12–14, 2:1–8
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-228-acts-1-1214-2-18.html
Passage: Acts 1:12-14
Points:
- The disciples returned from the Mount of Olives to wait and pray in the Jerusalem upper room.
- Apostles, women, Mary, and Jesus' brothers met as a devoted, unified praying community.
- God frequently uses small, humble gatherings of praying believers to accomplish extraordinary works.
- Faithful, expectant prayer positions God's people to receive the power of the Holy Spirit.
